description: V3.0 Data Foundation Program — single registry for every data source feeding EcoMOF-AI ingestion, validation, standardization, and benchmark readiness. Missing fields stay pending/unknown/ambiguous/restricted and are never fabricated.

sources.citation: Chung et al., Computation-Ready Experimental Metal-Organic Frameworks (CoRE MOF) 2019.
sources.notes: Backs the V2.2 verified-metadata preview records (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14132134). Only a curated subset is ingested; full database is not loaded.

sources.citation: Rosen et al., Quantum-Chemical Insights from Deep Learning over the QMOF Database.
sources.notes: Provides computed descriptors (band gap, void fraction) for a small curated subset. DFT-labelled reaction performance is not included.

sources.citation: Per-record literature DOIs retained in mof_candidates_real_seed.json (UiO-66, MOF-808, HKUST-1, MIL-101(Cr), ...).
sources.notes: 11 well-known MOFs with real publication DOIs. Structural provenance only; organic-acid reaction performance is not curated for these records.

sources.citation: Aggregated from CoRE/QMOF-style open seeds with sourceRecordId provenance.
sources.notes: 50 structural seeds with descriptors. DOI/license per record stay pending where not confirmed.
48 literature evidence claims; most sourceDoi remain null pending offline confirmation and are not fabricated.

sources.citation: Evidence ledger for OACS/DMRS descriptors and pathway claims.
sources.notes: 30 evidence records (literature_proxy / descriptor_inferred). DOIs stay null where unconfirmed.

sources.citation: Curated CO2-to-organic-acid experiment fixtures with reaction conditions and product distribution.
sources.notes: Small set of reaction-condition records. Treated as demonstration fixtures unless provenance is confirmed; not asserted as verified experimental labels.

sources.citation: Internal expert review of descriptor relevance and risk flags.
sources.notes: Qualitative review only; does not assert experimental measurement and is never used as a Gold-tier label.
